description: This is a Python script implementing a multi-process fuzzy testing framework for a program called 'fuzzer.py'. The script manages parallel execution of fuzzing seeds, handles output and ignore patterns, tracks statistics, and provides summary reporting, including progress bars and error handling.

classes.name: FuzzerResult
classes.description: Dataclass that stores the result of a fuzzing seed run, including seed value, success status, output, duration, ignored pattern index, and operation statistics.

methods.name: int is_ignored_output(output: str)
methods.description: Checks if the given output matches any of the predefined ignore patterns.

methods.name: FuzzerResult run_fuzzer_with_seed( seed: int, template: str = "default", supported_ops: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Executes the external 'fuzzer.py' script with specified seed and parameters, captures and parses output, determines ignore pattern matches, and returns a FuzzerResult.

methods.name: print_output_lines(output: str, write_func)
methods.description: Prints each non-empty line of the output through a specified write function, adding a blank line afterwards if the function is tqdm.write.

methods.name: handle_result_output( *, label: str, seed: int, duration: float, output: str, ignored: bool, verbose: bool, write_func, )
methods.description: Handles output formatting for fuzzing results, showing seed, duration, output, and whether it was ignored or successful, using a specified write function.

methods.name: None run_multi_process_fuzzer( num_processes: int | None = None, seed_start: int = 0, seed_count: int = 100, verbose: bool = False, template: str = "default", supported_ops: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Runs the fuzzing process across multiple processes for a range of seeds, manages progress display, aggregates results, and provides a detailed summary upon completion or interruption.

methods.name: None _print_operation_distribution(results: list[FuzzerResult])
methods.description: Aggregates and displays the total number of operations executed across all successful fuzzing runs, sorted by operation name.

methods.name: None run_until_failure( num_processes: int | None = None, verbose: bool = False, template: str = "default", supported_ops: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Continuously runs the fuzzing process with random seed initializations until a failure is detected, then reports the failure details and stops.
